Hi Rajeev, thanks for the changes, maybe we can add these two fixes to topic `dsp0267_v130_ci` for passing CI, since the libpldm API is not stabilized yet.
nit: Anti-pattern log
Ack. The message was redundant here as well; all error paths already log the necessary details.
Can you also state why EM config may not be available?
Acknowledged
On what platform?
Updated the commit message. Testing was done on B40.
Doesn't getBoardPath handle this already?

getBoardPath doesn't handle "no Entity-Manager config" scenario because it requires an inventory path as an input - which isn’t available if EM isn’t configured.

While we could catch the exception from the dbus call, I think it’s unnecessary to make a dbus request in this situation.
Can we remove this log?
Acknowledged
Can we remove this log? We will have the path on D-Bus.
Acknowledged
Does this show up as a D-Bus association and Redfish? If so, please show that in the testing output.

```
root@gb200nvl-obmc:~# busctl get-property xyz.openbmc_project.PLDM /xyz/openbmc_project/software/PLDM_Device_Firmware_Device_13_Component_49152_73 xyz.openbmc_project.Association.Definitions Associations
a(sss) 1 "running" "ran_on" "/xyz/openbmc_project/inventory/system/board/PLDM_Device"
```

Association with chassis or board URI is not shown on Redfish.
We only show Manager URI for BMC and System/{}/Bios for bios in RelateItems
for other URIs, we don't show anything
